title: Ganesha and the race around the world.
lines: Long ago, in India, high in the mountains, lived a very special family.
Daddy was called Shiva and Mummy was called Parvati.
And they had two sons.
One son was called Kartikeya.
He was fast and strong, and he had a beautiful peacock with long blue and green feathers.
He could fly through the sky on that peacock.
Whoosh!
The other son was called Ganesha.
And Ganesha looked very special.
He had the head of an elephant!
With big flappy ears, a long trunk and two small clever eyes.
He had a big round tummy, because Ganesha loved sweets very much.
His favourite sweets were little sweet balls called modaks.
Mmm!
And Ganesha had a very small friend who carried him everywhere.
A mouse!
The mouse was called Mushika.
Squeak squeak!
Ganesha may not have been the fastest, but he was very clever.
That's why people still come to Ganesha when they start something new.
One day Daddy Shiva was given a present.
A very special mango.
A golden mango that sparkled in the sun.
Whoever eats this mango, said Daddy, will become very wise.
I want it!
shouted Kartikeya.
No, I want it!
shouted Ganesha.
Mummy Parvati laughed.
We only have one mango, she said.
So let's have a race.
Whoever goes around the whole world three times first gets the golden mango.
Kartikeya jumped straight onto his peacock.
That's easy!
My peacock flies super fast.
See you later!
And whoosh, off he went.
Over the mountains, over the seas, over the forests and over the deserts.
Ganesha looked at his little mouse.
Mushika looked back.
Squeak?
Oh dear.
Around the whole world with a little mouse?
That would take a hundred years!
Ganesha sat down and thought.
He thought and thought.
His big ears flapped, and his trunk curled.
What is the world, really?
he thought.
What is the most important thing to me?
And then he knew!
He stood up and asked Mummy and Daddy: Would you sit here together for a moment?
Mummy and Daddy sat down next to each other.
And then Ganesha began to walk.
With his mouse beside him he walked around his mummy and daddy.
Once around.
Twice around.
Three times around.
Then he bowed and said: Done!
Mummy and Daddy looked surprised.
But Ganesha, said Mummy, you didn't go around the world.
Oh yes I did, said Ganesha with a smile.
You are my whole world.
You have given me everything.
My daddy and my mummy are more important to me than all the mountains and all the seas together.
Mummy and Daddy were so touched.
What a clever and kind boy you are, said Daddy.
You have won!
And he gave Ganesha the golden mango.
A while later Kartikeya came back on his peacock.
He was tired and sweaty.
I flew around the world three times!
I won!
But then he saw that Ganesha already had the mango.
How can that be?
Ganesha explained everything.
At first Kartikeya was a little angry.
But then he understood.
Mummy and Daddy are my whole world too, he said softly.
And do you know what Ganesha did then?
He took the golden mango and broke it into two pieces.
One piece for me, and one piece for you, brother.
Sharing is even tastier.
And the two brothers ate the sweet mango together, while the mouse and the peacock happily walked around.
Mmm!
